features.title: Install and start tC4
features.where: Your computer's Downloads folder, then the tC4 app or the start-tc4.sh launcher
features.summary: Download the build for your computer, install or unpack it, and start the app. It opens on the Home screen.
steps: Get the build for your computer from the tC4 releases page: the .exe installer for Windows, the .pkg installer for macOS, or the .zip for Linux.
Windows: run the .exe. Windows SmartScreen warns about an unsigned app: choose More info , then Run anyway . Start tC4 from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut.

macOS: open the .pkg. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway . The installer asks for an administrator password. Then start translationCore 4 from Applications.
Linux: unpack the zip, open a terminal in the unpacked translationCore4 folder and run ./start-tc4.sh.
Wait for the window. tC4 opens on Home, with the heading Your projects.
To start your first project, click + Add a project. See The Home screen.
expected: The window opens on Home within about 30 seconds, with the heading Your projects.
With no projects yet, Home says "No projects yet. Select + Add a project to start."
No error banner shows.
